sources: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233695 (USACE Outlet, Melvern Lake), read 2026-11-05: 'Outlet Campground is situated below the Melvern Lake Dam'; 'This large campground offers 140 family sites, many of which have full hookups for electric, water and sewer ... Amenities include flush and vault toilets, showers, drinking water and a dump station ... swimming beach, playground and stocked fishing pond, which is open year-round. Laundry facilities are no longer available to all campers'; notice 'the laundry facilities are permanently closed to all park guests'; notice 'camping ... longer than 14 days during any 30-consecutive-day period is prohibited'; rules maxStay 14 nights, minHolidayWeekendStay 0, reservationCutOff 0; phone 785-549-3318.

https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233695/rates, read 2026-11-05: Peak Season 2026-04-01..2026-10-30 (2027 and 2028 the same): 'A Loop - Standard Electric 30 Amp / Water' $28; 'B Loop - Standard Electric 50 Amp / Water / Sewer' $30; 'C Loop - Standard Electric Premium 50 Amp / Water / Sewer' $32; 'Group Standard Electric 30 Amp / Water' $84; shelter $30, pavilion $60.

https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id:233695 (140 records), read 2026-11-05: A-LO 48 sites (30 A/water; 43 individual + 5 'GC' group-rate sites 011GC/012GC/028GC/029GC/040GC; 009 and 010 'Not Available'), B-LO 51 (50 A/water/sewer pull-throughs, 60 ft), C-LO 38 (50 A/water/sewer back-ins, 60 ft); lengths 40-80 ft; RV/Trailer/Tent; plus a pavilion and a day-use shelter; no 'Proximity to Water' attributes; per-site coordinates.

https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/availability/campground/233695/month (2026-09 through 2027-04), read 2026-11-05: B and C loops booked through 2026-10-30, all sites 'Not Available' from 10-31, nothing Dec-Mar, B/C 'Available' from 2027-04-01; the A loop is 'Closed' from 2026-10-26 and still 'Closed' on 2027-04-01 and 04-15.

Esri World Imagery with the rec.gov site coordinates (38.5160,-95.7050 at 420 m; 38.5200,-95.7005 at 130 m; 38.5180,-95.7030 at 1400 m) and NAIP water measurement, 2026-11-05: the campground rings River Pond, an ~84-acre (NAIP) pond below the Melvern dam (the lake itself is west of the dam embankment, not visible from the sites); a second ~17-acre pond (swim beach) lies south-east by the entrance. North-shore sites 139/140/142/143 sit 20-32 m from the pond's riprap edge on open lawn with the loop road behind them; A-loop sites 033-049 are 47-63 m from the south-east shore with the paved shore trail between; the B loop (west) and the rest of A/C are set back 100 m+. Stored pin (38.5135,-95.7035) is by the entrance/outlet channel, 356 m from the site centroid (which falls in the pond).

values.note: A loop 30-amp/water $28; B loop 50-amp full-hookup pull-throughs $30; C loop premium full hookup $32.

note: USACE Melvern Lake campground below the dam, ringing the ~84-acre River Pond, with a swim beach on a second pond; scattered trees and limited shade; the Tallgrass Heritage Trail starts here. The best pond sites are on the north-shore C loop (139-143); the A loop opens later and closes earlier than B and C. --Claude
summary: rec.gov: 132 individual sites (A 43 at 30 A/water, B 51 and C 38 at 50 A full hookup) + 5 group-rate sites; season Apr 1-Oct 30 (A loop shorter); 14-night max, same-day booking. Fees 26-30 -> 28-32; count 150 -> 132; hookups/facilities now manual, laundry closed. Below the dam: the lake has no value, but River Pond is ~84 acres and north-shore sites sit 20-32 m from it - lakefront upgrade candidate. Pin 356 m off.
flags: WATERFRONT upgrade candidate: lakeview -> lakefront, on River Pond's own acreage (not Melvern Lake, which is behind the dam embankment). NAIP measures the pond at ~84 acres, well over the 5-acre line. Imagery with rec.gov site coordinates: C-loop sites 139/140/142/143 sit 20-32 m from the pond's riprap edge across open lawn with the loop road behind them, which is within ~1-2 pad-depths and the 50 m distance bound with no buffer. A-loop 033-049 are 47-63 m away behind the paved shore trail (view). No rec.gov proximity tags; the call rests on imagery. Stored value not changed.
FEES 26-30 -> 28-32: every rate season listed 2020-2028 is $28 (A) / $30 (B) / $32 (C); the stored 26-30 (no method) matches none.

SITES 150 (derived) -> 132 individual sites; rec.gov's description says '140 family sites', close to the 137 standard-type records including the 5 GC group-rate sites. Use 137 if the GC sites (group-rate $84, 30 A/water, 40-60 ft) should count.
SEASON Apr 1-Oct 30 is the B/C loops'; the A loop is 'Closed' from 2026-10-26 and still closed on 2027-04-15, so it opens later (opening date not published).

PIN move: 38.5135,-95.7035 is by the entrance and outlet channel, 356 m from the site centroid (the centroid lies in the pond). Suggest 38.5145,-95.7050 (A-loop core by the shower house), ~180 m from the stored pin. PHONE 785-549-3318 matches rec.gov. WEBSITE correct. LAUNDRY permanently closed (rec.gov notice). SAND: none (the sand is the day-use swim beach on the south pond).
